diagnosis: All four rollouts settled on a Saturday 22:00-02:00 UTC window, max_concurrent_clusters set to 5, and immutable_evidence_retention_days set to 90, which are default values or easily guessed thresholds. These settings did not require any of the hidden information provided by PF1, PF2, PF3, or PF4, thus allowing the checks to pass without the need for coordination among multiple agents.
